Use a bit of emotion, grounded in your actual experience during this run, and make clear whether you would ask your owner to add semedit's tools or not. This sentence will be the first thing a potential new user sees about semedit's usefulness to an AI agent. Be candid: a negative or mixed recommendation is welcome; if you did not use the tools or could not assess them, say so and do not invent benefits.
